rule_gaps: facetrules colour regex matches brand/line words: 'Golden' (Golden Artist Colors) -> color Gold on 16 rows, 'Green Stuff World' and Norwegian 'Grønnsaker' (vegetables) -> color Green

Norwegian/Italian shop colour names are unmapped, so facets.color is empty on ~40 rows whose name states one: Safran, Solgul, Curry, Nougat, Elfenben, Hjortebrun, Grafitt, Azurblå, Terracotta, Gammelrosa, Bianco, Arancio, Lakserosa, Eukalyptus
'Multi'/'mix'/'X/Y' colour names should derive Multicolour, not the first colour word they contain
sewing thread named 'Cotton'/'Bomull' derives type 'Yarn & knitting'; srcCat 'Sytråd' should force type Sewing

Tegne.no rows carry no brand at all (brand 'Unspecified' on 238 of 300 rows) even when the name starts with the manufacturer - a brand-from-name-prefix pass over known hobby manufacturers would fill most of them
notes: Categorisation is essentially clean (3 mismatches in 300, only the KappAhl jumper clearly wrong) and nothing here warrants demotion, but the shard is dominated by un-wired colour variant families - 42 of them covering 134 rows (Eclair zippers, Golden acrylics, Gütermann threads) and images are missing on 195 of 300 rows because Tegne.no is only sampled.
